newsitem.title: THAILAND: National Finance says to submit banking plan.
newsitem.headline: National Finance says to submit banking plan.

text.p: National Finance and Securities Plc is preparing to lead a group of finance and securities firms that will apply for a commercial banking licence, the Thai broker said on Friday.
"According to a board meeting held on June 26 the company resolved to take a leading role in a merger seeking approval to set up a commercial bank," the firm said in a statement.

"We have been working with the central bank on this for some time and have set up a division to make a plan ... and to define purchase and assumption," said assistant vice-president Apichart Intravisit.
